snippet.title: The Lonesome Guild - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Launch Trailer for The Lonesome Guild, a stylized action-adventure hand-drawn game developed by Tiny Bull Studios. Players will embark on a heartfelt adventure with a group of unique characters across a world consumed by loneliness and friendship. The Lomesone Guild is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
